topic.title: Allotments / Statutory Disposal / Replacement
topic.source_contract: statutory allotment status, demand and occupancy, disposal authority, Secretary of State consent, alternatives, replacement land, planning decision, transfer, implementation and community-use evidence

scope_guards: Council ownership is not proof that allotment land is non-statutory.
Low occupancy is not proof of no local demand.
A council resolution is not Secretary of State consent.
Consent to dispose is not planning permission.
Planning permission is not completed disposal.
Identified replacement land is not a functioning allotment site.
Site closure is not treated as successful replacement provision.
No score or promotion is written without exact consent, replacement, implementation and use evidence.
